content.question: What is overfitting?
options: When a model learns the training data too well, including its noise, and performs poorly on unseen data.
When a model is too simple to capture the patterns in the training data.
When a model performs poorly on training data but well on validation data.
When a model trains too slowly because of an excessive learning rate.
content.answer: When a model learns the training data too well, including its noise, and performs poorly on unseen data.
